record.original_question: Let K1 , K2 , K3 be disjoint closed sets in the extended complex plane, and C1 , C2 , C3 constants. Let ρn (f ) be the best rational approximation to the function f which equals Ci on Ki (i = 1, 2, 3); i.e. ρn (f ) = inf max |f (z) − g(z)|, g∈Rn z∈∪i Ki where Rn is the class of rational functions f order at most n. Find a geometric 1/n characterisation of limn→∞ ρn . For the case of two sets, see Gonchar [333]. (T. Ganelius)

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $K_1, K_2, K_3$ be three pairwise disjoint closed subsets of the extended complex plane $\widehat{\mathbb{C}} = \mathbb{C} \cup \{\infty\}$, and let $C_1, C_2, C_3$ be three complex constants. Define the function $f$ on $K := K_1 \cup K_2 \cup K_3$ by $f(z) = C_i$ for $z \in K_i$, $i = 1, 2, 3$. For each positive integer $n$, let $R_n$ denote the class of rational functions of degree at most $n$, and define the best uniform rational approximation error
$$\rho_n(f) = \inf_{g \in R_n} \, \max_{z \in K} |f(z) - g(z)|.$$
Provide a geometric characterization (in terms of the configuration of the sets $K_1, K_2, K_3$, e.g.\ in terms of capacities, condenser problems, or potential-theoretic quantities) of the limit
$$\lim_{n \to \infty} \rho_n(f)^{1/n}.$$
(The case of two sets was settled by Gonchar, who showed that the analogous limit equals $e^{-1/\mathrm{cap}(K_1,K_2)}$, where $\mathrm{cap}(K_1,K_2)$ is the capacity of the condenser with plates $K_1$ and $K_2$.)
artifact.status_search_result: A web search did not yield a definitive geometric characterization for the three-set case of this best rational approximation problem. While Gonchar's two-set theorem (characterization via condenser capacity) is classical, and Stahl addressed several related Gonchar conjectures on rational approximation in 1987, no clear resolution of the three-set geometric characterization could be confirmed from the available sources.

status_evidence.title: A note on three conjectures by Gonchar on rational approximation
status_evidence.snippet: Stahl addresses three conjectures of Gonchar on rational approximation.
status_evidence.claim: Related conjectures of Gonchar on rational approximation have been partially addressed, but the specific three-set geometric characterization is not clearly resolved.

status_evidence.title: Rational approximation of analytic functions
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of rational approximation including Gonchar-type results.
status_evidence.claim: Surveys of rational approximation theory describe the two-set condenser-capacity result but do not provide a definitive geometric characterization for three or more sets.
